Functional has 44 binary criteria with unique ids, minimum weight 0.5, sum 59.5. Polish has 5 binary criteria, unique ids, weights 1.5-3. Prompts resolve: each prompt.md exists, contains {criteria} once and {app_context} once and no other {placeholder}, opens http://localhost:3000, and test.sh:195-201 substitutes app_context.md into tests/*/*/prompt.md.
